name: bugtongph
description: Conversational, gated production pipeline for Filipino video episodes: a Notion-backed bugtong riddle or a model-invented topic, then location, environment, locked character/style/voice profiles, script, a stacked-strip shot-reference sheet image, and copy-ready Google Flow / Veo 3.1 Lite clip prompts.

interface.longDescription: Makes short Filipino videos for Google Flow (Veo 3.1 Lite). The subject is a bugtong riddle from your Notion database or the built-in set, or a topic the AI invents (.topic). You get one shot-reference image, made here in ChatGPT, and one to three copy-ready clip prompts, 8 seconds each, to paste into Flow. Type .auto and it picks everything, pausing after the image prompt, the image, and the clip prompts; send .auto again to continue. Or go one step at a time (.riddle, .location, .environment, .profile, .script, .frame, .image, .clips) and choose from three options at each. .auto draft gives every prompt without making the image. The riddle's answer is never shown in the image or the clips. Tagalog by default; add english or bisaya. Notion is optional.
defaultPrompt: .auto - make a whole episode. Send .auto again at each pause.
.riddle - build it step by step and choose at every stage.
.auto draft - get the image prompt and clip prompts, no image made.
